answer: Written in a historical context, lessons from prior systems register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the gale of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on sharding with cross-shard communication protocols. Work waits on the sable until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
